text:
maya (Marketing): Hey team — planning a coordinated launch for the new OSS refapp (mentor-journey) next month. Need launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar, and inbound routing. thoughts? :rocket:
arlo (DevRel): Love it. We should make the tutorial a 20-25 min hands-on walkthrough + a 10 min live demo. Low friction: repo + one-command local run.
maya (Marketing): Yes. Priority order: 1) blog post + benchmark highlight, 2) tutorial repo + quickstart, 3) webinar with live demo, 4) lead routing & follow-up flows.
sam (Product): For benchmarks, let's surface cost/latency tradeoffs for three modes: hosted, dedicated, private. Headline idea: "Ship faster, serve cheaper: Mentor-Journey refapp benchmarks"
jun (Eng): I'll add a tiny benchmark script in repo. Want numbers for p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec for each config. I'll add a README section describing hardware.
lia (Growth): On inbound routing — we need a UTM + SFDC mapping. Proposed fields: campaign=refapp_mentor_launch, content=webinar|blog|tutorial. Also add lead_source tag so SDRs can filter.
lia (Growth): Example snippet for the lead payload:```json
{
  "lead_source": "refapp_mentor_launch",
  "utm_campaign": "mentor_launch_2026",
  "origin": "blog:webinar:tutorial"
}
```
sam (Product): Good. Also include an interest boolean for Dedicated/Private so AE can prioritize.
arlo (DevRel): Webinar plan: title "Build a Mentor Flow with Redwood Inference"; speakers: me + jun; demo runs the refapp end-to-end (local -> hosted fallback). Ask maya for CTR-focused slides.
maya (Marketing): I'll draft blog + slide deck. Can someone pull a 2-sentence exec summary for the top of the post? Keep it benefits-first: speed, cost, predictable results, easy deploys.
jun (Eng): Quick exec copy: "Mentor-Journey shows how to integrate LLM inference into product UX with predictable latency and cost — featuring benchmarks across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
lia (Growth): For registration form: include checkbox options: "Interested in dedicated capacity" and "Request on-prem POC". That maps to AE routing rules.
arlo (DevRel): We'll open a repo issue for the tutorial script + the demo dataset. Tag: devrel/mentor-launch.
release-bot: Scheduled release window created for 2026-04-14 10:00UTC. Link: https://releases.internal/mentor-launch-1762345670
maya (Marketing): Timeline check: blog draft due 2026-03-31, tutorial PR due 2026-04-04, webinar prereg opens 2026-04-06. Can everyone confirm? :eyes:
jun (Eng): Confirmed, will push benchmark PR by 04-04.
arlo (DevRel): Confirmed for tutorial assets.
sam (Product): Confirmed for benchmark narrative + exec summary.
lia (Growth): I'll wire the SFDC flow and share the form schema by 2026-04-05.
maya (Marketing): Awesome — I'll post a short launch checklist in this thread tomorrow with publish times and sample social copy. :thumbsup:
